step_metadata.name: Functional Requirements Extraction
step_metadata.description: Extract and validate functional requirements from foundational documents

detailed_guidance.purpose: Convert high-level mission statement and user scenarios into specific, testable functional requirements
detailed_guidance.what_is_a_functional_requirement: A functional requirement describes WHAT the system must do (a capability or behavior), independent of HOW it does it or WHICH component implements it.

good_functional_requirements: FR-001: System shall authenticate users via username/password
FR-002: System shall validate user input for SQL injection attacks
FR-003: System shall generate monthly usage reports
FR-004: System shall notify users when tasks are completed
bad_examples_not_functional: Use PostgreSQL database (implementation detail, not functional requirement)
Service A shall call Service B (allocation detail, not functional requirement)
Use microservices architecture (architectural decision, not functional requirement)

extraction_method.step_1: Read mission statement - extract top-level business capabilities
extraction_method.step_2: Read each user scenario - extract required system behaviors
extraction_method.step_3: Read success criteria - extract measurable functional requirements

what_it_checks: All user scenarios traceable to at least one functional requirement
No conflicting requirements (e.g., FR-001 and FR-005 contradict each other)
All success criteria satisfied by functional requirements

common_pitfalls: Mixing functional requirements with implementation details (e.g., 'Use Docker' is not a functional requirement)
Mixing functional requirements with service allocation (e.g., 'Auth service validates passwords' - that's allocation, not requirement)
Missing requirements because user scenarios not fully analyzed
Requirements too vague to validate (e.g., 'System shall be user-friendly' - not testable)
Skipping validation step - proceeding without 100% user scenario coverage
typical_time: 30-60 minutes for small systems, 2-4 hours for complex systems
